summary: Full E2E of Robson Club SaaS (FastAPI+Mongo backend + React frontend via public URL). 25/25 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend flows tested: login/logout/route guards, RBAC redirect, influencer dashboard (period, featured coupon, campaigns, statement), partner coupon validation (invalid=red / valid=green preview, live calc, POST redemption persists after reload), referral submission, admin lead approval, admin CRUD (create/list campaigns, users no password column, ebooks 12, parceiros grows after approval), messages (admin→influencer new-conversation + send + reply, unread badge=1), ebooks filters (Espanha => 1 card), preview modal, notifications badge.

issues: Loading state text 'A carregar...' shown in the conversation list panel is acceptable but there is no data-testid for it; may cause selector races in automation. Consider adding data-testid='conversations-loading'.

critical_code_review_comments: seed.py stores ADMIN_PASSWORD in plain env and re-hashes on every startup if password verify fails — OK because seed rehashes; verified idempotent.

routes_data.py:151 duplicate-guard window is 10s partner+code+amount — user may legitimately re-key same amount within 10s; consider surfacing a clearer 409 message with cool-down time (currently 'Redenção duplicada bloqueada (idempotência).').
routes_admin.py list_items has no role dependency on the endpoint level — protected via router-level Depends(require_role('admin')). Good.
public_user strips password_hash; verified by listing /api/admin/usuarios.

routes_messages.allowed_contacts: partner contacts = admins + users of influencers of partner's campaigns; influencer contacts = admins + users tied to partners of influencer's campaigns. Belcanto (p2) has campaign c2 for if1, so robson can talk to reservas@belcanto.pt as expected.
Cookie set with SameSite=None+Secure — fine for cross-site preview URL; also token returned in JSON body used by frontend axios (localStorage 'robson_token').

No CORS_ORIGINS restriction (defaults to '*') combined with allow_credentials=True is unusual; browsers will treat '*' as invalid when credentials=true. Since frontend uses Bearer via header (not cookies), this doesn't break the app, but recommend setting explicit origins for production.
seed_data_creation: During tests: created ephemeral leads/partners/campaigns/users prefixed with random UUIDs. Some test-created campaigns (UI-TEST-*, TEST-*) may remain in DB; no cleanup impacts prod flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Frontend flows all working. Redemptions with same partner+code+amount within 10s are rejected with 409 by design (idempotency guard). Admin demo login = adm-2 (admin@robson.club). Owner admin adm-1 = faellt@gmail.com/Robson2026!. Note CORS_ORIGINS='*' + credentials=true is a latent config smell but does not break current flows since frontend uses Bearer header.
